caption:
"Everyone has a CRM and text-back now. Why would automation make me any different?"

Fair question. Here's the honest answer.

Owning the software was never the edge. Running it on every single lead, every time, is the part almost nobody does.

Industry data still shows only about 17% of service businesses answer a new lead within an hour, even with better tools sitting on the desk than ever before.

Answer within five minutes instead, and you get about double the odds of closing that lead.

Operating the tool on every lead is the real differentiator.
